_comment: False-positive attractors that must produce nothing, and one real defect that must. The four notes carry [[500, 375]] in a python fence, [[wikilinks]] in inline code, a tilde fence, a markdown link written [[1](url)], a colon and a hash inside quoted scalars — all of which a naive scanner reports as links. The trap inputs exist to keep ZK008 and ZK028 silent, so the one finding that survives is the whole report. The isolated note is the other direction: it is listed in structure/index.md, and index links are excluded from the inbound count, so being indexed does not make it linked.
